newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, resists downward pressure.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, resists downward pressure.

text.p: NWE naphtha were steady on Friday, having trimmed small gains achieved earlier on the back of a small bounce in crude futures, in quiet lacklustre trade.
Feb swaps pared earlier gains to return to the $221/$222 a tonne level seen at the end of Thursday's session.
Cargoes were little changed at $223/$225 cif with a cargo changing hands at $225 in afternoon trade. A 10,000 tonne parcel was done at $215.50.
Brokers said the market was likely to be fairly quiet in the coming week due to Institute of Petroleum events in London which would take a number of continental players out of the market.
They added that the thinner volume could make the market more susceptible to price manipulation.
The market has been keenly monitoring a stand-off between an aggressive seller, who bid at $223 on Friday, and two other traders who were trying to support prices.
